description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, owner or project scope): rename a share, retarget its local port or change its policy with PATCH /api/v1/shares/:id. A policy change bumps website.share.policy_version so the edge's signed cache is stale at once; changing the public label needs the name registry, and a taken or reserved label is refused. Project scope comes from the token, never the body.
